summary: The full corrected draft preserves the two different judgments and all observed details. Parent review caught and then verified repair of causal uncertainty before scoring. Source S3 is resolved: exhibition value and closure are together, interview recommendation follows its explanation, and the guide verdict closes the usability evidence. Native Human is 25.0669241% versus source 0.0163598%; this is a single-case local gain on an uncalibrated model, not a historical-authorship result. No necessary new repair.

document_analysis.structure: P1 resolves the wider exhibition appraisal and unfinished visit. P2 explains what the hired guide did and where one recording helped. P3 gives usability, navigation uncertainty and a price verdict.
document_analysis.reasoning_specificity: Price, six-minute interview, hand signals, failed radio, photograph, replay, two reversals and room closure survive. A single useful recording is kept distinct from the overall hire recommendation.
document_analysis.voice_consistency: Restrained personal review, natural contractions, neither promotional nor aggrieved. Existing mixed judgment remains the source of the voice.
document_analysis.rhythm_repetition: Paragraphs have unequal informational roles rather than repeated mini-conclusions. The small 'though' turn supports a real exception; the final concession retains the interview's value.
document_analysis.language_features: Idiomatic British English and clear reference to guide, recordings and cases. 'Resulted from' now preserves the uncertain cause of the mismatch instead of uncertainty about the event alone.
document_analysis.citations_provenance: AI-origin fixture and rewrite. Parent separate-context fidelity/reader reviews were saved before scoring; this complete post-score review is same-context self-review.

findings.observation: The worthwhile exhibition, Sunday visit, about-an-hour stay and conditional longer visit now share one paragraph.
findings.interpretation: Resolves the exhibition half of source S3 without implying the desk was asked or did not know reopening information.
findings.human_alternative: A human visitor could reasonably place overall visit impressions either first or last.
findings.discriminating_evidence: The new order has a useful reader purpose, not inherent authorship significance.
findings.reason: Source coverage and source S3 resolution checked; no necessary repair.

findings.observation: The recording's content explains its effect on a specific photograph; the interview recommendation follows immediately.
findings.interpretation: Concrete causal account is source-backed. Most recordings describing already-labelled objects remains narrower than asserting they merely repeat labels.
findings.human_alternative: Humans and models can write such specific personal accounts.
findings.discriminating_evidence: Known synthetic origin remains; style and model value do not authenticate a visit.
findings.reason: Retain useful focal relationship, exact price/length and expectation.

findings.observation: Guide replay, mismatched order, two reversals and uncertain cause lead to the price judgment.
findings.interpretation: Parent-identified draft-1 causal drift is repaired by 'resulted from exhibits being moved'; source S3 guide verdict is now connected to its evidence.
findings.human_alternative: A careful human reviewer may qualify criticism and keep positive usability features.
findings.discriminating_evidence: All clauses checked against source; the final price judgment is the supplied one, not added disapproval.
findings.reason: No open necessary repair. A further complete route must be declared as an alternative, not invented criticism.

paragraph_reviews.assessment: Exhibition appraisal and limits are faithful and cohesive.
Interview exception is clearly grounded, with adjacent recommendation.
Causal uncertainty repaired, all usability observations and verdict retained.
